_purpose: The frozen baseline for DEFECT-STALE-SANDBOX (PROJECT_CHARTER.html, Named Defect Classes; operator ruling #105(1), 2026-10-07). Every verify_ test that extracts functions from qr.html BY NAME without loading the engine through _engine.js (engineAwareFindFn / require('./_engine.js')) is listed here, frozen as of T156. verify_stale_sandbox_baseline.js holds the list: a NEW cherry-picker fails, and a listed test that has stopped cherry-picking (or been deleted) also fails until it is removed from this list. The list only shrinks. DEFECT-STALE-SANDBOX is closed when it is empty.
_how_it_shrinks: Migrate a test: replace its by-name sandbox with engineAwareFindFn(<its extractor>) (see verify_access_removed_catalog_wide.js for the pattern) or load the modules whole through engine().wrapper (see verify_shadow_mode_broad_sweep_phase5_5.js), confirm it still passes, then delete its name from cherry_pickers AND lower ceiling by one, in the same commit. Never add a name: a new test uses the loader. Never raise the ceiling: the detector refuses a ceiling above the count it shipped with (42), and refuses a ceiling that differs from the list length.
_scope: Engine modules (pricing, nlp, orchestrator). Tests that cherry-pick functions from the renderer, store or glue layers are listed too (the list is the true count of cherry-pickers), but their remedy, a whole-module loader per layer, is a separate step (PENDING_DECISIONS #111).
